mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_dataset (code, name, description, jurisdiction, embedding_model, doc_count, chunk_count) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{jurisdiction}, #{embeddingModel}, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_dataset d SET doc_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document x WHERE x.dataset_id = d.id), chunk_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_chunk c WHERE c.dataset_id = d.id), update_time = NOW() WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (dataset_id, title, source_type, jurisdiction, effective_date, status, content, char_count, chunk_count) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{jurisdiction}, #{effectiveDate}, #{status}, #{content}, #{charCount}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET chunk_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO kb_chunk (dataset_id, document_id, chunk_no, article_no, content, tokens, embedding) VALUES (#{chunk.datasetId}, #{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.chunkNo}, #{chunk.articleNo}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.tokens},
CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_chunk

SELECT c.id, c.dataset_id, c.document_id, d.title AS document_title, c.chunk_no, c.article_no, c.content, c.tokens, ROUND((1 - (c.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))::numeric, 4)::double precision AS score FROM kb_chunk c LEFT JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND c.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY c.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.dataset_id, c.document_id, d.title AS document_title, c.chunk_no, c.article_no, c.content, c.tokens, 0.5::double precision AS score FROM kb_chunk c LEFT JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND c.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, dataset_id, document_id, chunk_no, article_no, content, tokens FROM kb_chunk WHERE embedding IS NULL AND content IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_chunk SET embedding = CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) WHERE id = #{id}

CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, law_name, article_no, title, jurisdiction, effective_date, status, content, tags, version, ROUND((1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))::numeric, 4)::double precision AS score FROM legal_article WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, code, law_name, article_no, title, jurisdiction, effective_date, status, content, tags, version, 0.5::double precision AS score FROM legal_article WHERE (content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR law_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR article_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND jurisdiction = #{jurisdiction} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, code, law_name, article_no, title, jurisdiction, effective_date, status, content, tags, version, ROUND((1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))::numeric, 4)::double precision AS score FROM legal_article WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL AND jurisdiction = #{jurisdiction} ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ROUND((1 - (l.embedding <=> r.embedding))::numeric, 4)::double precision FROM legal_article l, legal_article r WHERE l.id = #{leftId} AND r.id = #{rightId} AND l.embedding IS NOT NULL AND r.embedding IS NOT NULL

SELECT a.id AS article_id, a.law_name AS law_name, a.article_no AS article_no, a.jurisdiction AS jurisdiction, a.status AS status, a.version AS version, a.effective_date AS effective_date, a.update_time AS article_update_time, d.id AS document_id, d.title AS document_title, d.source_type AS source_type, d.create_time AS document_create_time, ds.id AS dataset_id, ds.code AS dataset_code, ds.name AS dataset_name FROM legal_article a LEFT JOIN kb_document d ON d.title = a.law_name OR d.title LIKE CONCAT(a.law_name, '%') OR a.law_name LIKE CONCAT(d.title, '%') LEFT JOIN kb_dataset ds ON ds.id = d.dataset_id WHERE a.id IN #{id} ORDER BY a.id, d.id
SELECT jurisdiction AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS total FROM legal_article GROUP BY jurisdiction ORDER BY total DESC

mapper.select: SELECT id, article_id, action, code, law_name, article_no, title, summary, operator_name, operate_time FROM kb_article_log ORDER BY operate_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
